title: Chashmonai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Megillah 11a says: “Nor did I abhor them”—in the Greeks' days, when I raised up for them Shimon the Righteous, Chashmonai and his sons, and Matityahu the High Priest. Hyman says that the names of his righteous and pious sons are not mentioned in the Talmud.

notes.text: The names’ absence from the Talmud is Hyman’s assertion, not a new exhaustive search. The source describes the sons themselves as righteous and pious.
Megillah 11a gives this order and refers to Chashmonai’s sons collectively. The statement about their names across the Talmud is Hyman’s.
